children: key shareholders, Alexandre Birman and Roberto Jatahy, have signed a corporate reorganization agreement, the company said in a securities filing on Wednesday.

The reorganization effectively separates the Arezzo and Soma businesses under their original controlling groups, ending months of governance tensions and creating two independently managed, publicly traded fashion companies.
Azzas 2154 to be split into two separately listed companies
Arezzo&Co (Birman-led) will house brands Arezzo, Schutz, Anacapri, Vans, Alexandre Birman, Carol Bassi and Hering
SOMA (Jatahy-led) will house brands Animale, NV, Maria Filo, Cris Barros, Reserva, Oficina and Foxton
FARM Rio will become a separate jointly owned company, with Arezzo&Co holding 57.4% and SOMA 42.6%
Post-reorganization ownership, the Birman block will hold 32.13% of Arezzo&Co and retain 6.18% of SOMA, while the Jatahy block will hold 25.95% of SOMA
